title: Invoice Approval Workflow — trigger payload
description:
Input contract for workflow wf_f8b5dee1, generated from the sentence:
"Send the invoice to accounting, if it is over $10k get CFO approval first, then log it in Snowflake"

Every property listed is read by a decision in the workflow. A payload
missing one of them produces a run that cannot evaluate its own gateways.

amount.description: Amount in USD. The workflow compares it against a threshold expressed in USD; sending another currency silently mis-routes the run. This field name was inferred from the source sentence rather than stated outright — confirm it matches your payload.

workflow.description: Run metadata supplied by the caller or the runtime.

correlationId.description: Stable per business transaction. Retry keys are derived from it, so it must not change between attempts.
